svg.title: Prakhar Gupta — Backend & security tooling
svg.desc: Backend & security tooling in TypeScript and Python. 13 merged pull requests in OWASP cve-lite-cli (773 stars) and 5 in Sugar Labs. 1,836 contributions in the last year, longest streak 109 days. OPEN TO SWE INTERNSHIPS · ANY TERM.
